spec_match.rationale: Reproduces the spec §4 example end to end with genuinely served headers: satisfying Connection-Allowlist, Allow-Connection-Allowlist-From naming the embedder, the refuse-both case, and the report-only variant, each framed under a real connectionallowlist attribute.

interactive.rationale: Four scenario buttons load real framed widgets that run two real fetches and post their reports; a header inspector fetches all four widget variants and dumps the actual response headers.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises real headers from this site's own server, real fetches to allowed/blocked paths, and honest baseline labelling — all delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Scenario C (refusal) and D (report-only does not satisfy) are first-class; a 5s no-report timeout records a possible genuine block on enforcing builds; the observed-vs-specified table keeps the two readings separate.

conformance.rationale: This page is the named observation route for three of the suite's manual assertions (non-opted-in blocked, allow-from loads, enforced fetch blocked); the headers it serves are the evidence for them.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (Playwright CDP) against the updated co-located _server.ts (verified on a disposable server instance, since the long-running demo server had cached the earlier module): scenarios A, C and D loaded, widgets reported sent-header sets matching the scenario (Connection-Allowlist / none / Report-Only), required-header absent, and both real fetches 200; the header inspector printed all four variants' live response headers; a fetch-path bug (missing /v157 prefix, 404s) was found by this run and fixed in _server.ts; zero page errors, 0px overflow both classes; desktop screenshot read in full.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts ca-lab-widget-reported per scenario with required/fetch outcomes, ca-lab-no-report for the possible-block branch, and ca-lab-headers-inspected.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; the pressed scenario button restyles background and color together (accent-blue + bg-ivory); widget pages link the shared stylesheet.

accessibility.rationale: Scenario buttons form a labelled group with aria-pressed state, the iframe is titled, verdict and report are aria-live, the comparison table is captioned with scoped headers.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both classes driven: 0px horizontal overflow, full-width frame, stacked scenario buttons with 44px height.

openQuestions.title: Run all four scenarios on an enforcing build and record the real blocks
openQuestions.detail: On a build with ConnectionAllowlistEmbeddedEnforcement active, scenario C and D frames should genuinely refuse to load (the timeout branch records this) and scenario A's widget should see its blocked/ping fetch fail while allowed/ping could be permitted by a path-scoped requirement. Capture those observations into the observed column and re-check the conformance manual assertions.

openQuestions.title: Note on live-server module caching for _server.ts fixes
openQuestions.detail: The running demo server caches co-located _server.ts modules on first import, so the fetch-path fix in this wave only takes effect on the next server restart/deploy. The committed module is verified correct (disposable instance, port 3077); after the next deploy, re-run the lab once on the live origin to confirm allowed/blocked ping return 200 there too.

guidanceConsulted.query: iframe embedded enforcement CSP opt-in headers
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prove policy behaviour with genuinely served headers and same-origin inspection rather than mocked responses.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All four variants are real responses from the feature's own Deno handler; the inspector reads them back via fetch().headers.

guidanceConsulted.query: toggle button group pressed state accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Expose selection state with aria-pressed and keep colour change paired with a programmatic state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Scenario buttons carry aria-pressed and the pressed style changes background and color together.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let monospace reports wrap and tables scroll in their own region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Reports use pre-wrap with overflow-wrap:anywhere; the comparison table scrolls inside a focusable wrapper; 0px page overflow at 360px.

summary: The §4 handshake with nothing narrated: real requirement attribute, really served opt-in headers in four variants, real in-widget fetches to path-distinguished endpoints, and a table that keeps this browser's observed baseline strictly apart from the specified enforcing outcome. Verified headlessly on Chromium 141 both classes; one real routing bug was caught and fixed during verification.
